name: CurrencyWallet
src_typeComment: Multi-currency wallet: Add/TrySpend/GetBalance per CurrencyDefinition asset instead of hardcoding a single "gold" int. Wire OnBalanceChanged to a UI counter (pairs well with AnimatedNumberCounter). GetSaveData()/LoadSaveData() bridge to SaveSystem/JsonHelper — currencies are saved by their string Id (from GameDataAsset), not by direct asset reference, since a plain JSON save file can't meaningfully reference a ScriptableObject asset across sessions.

src_serialized.name: startingBalances
src_serialized.tooltip: Balances this wallet starts with — assign a CurrencyDefinition asset per row.

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent<CurrencyDefinition, int, int> OnBalanceChanged = new UnityEvent<CurrencyDefinition, int, int>()
src_members.name: UnityEvent
src_members.comment: currency, newBalance, delta (positive for Add, negative for a successful TrySpend)

src_members.sig: public int GetBalance(CurrencyDefinition currency) => balances.TryGetValue(currency, out int amount) ? amount : 0
src_members.name: GetBalance

src_members.sig: public bool CanAfford(CurrencyDefinition currency, int amount) => GetBalance(currency) >= amount
src_members.name: CanAfford

src_members.sig: public void Add(CurrencyDefinition currency, int amount)
src_members.name: Add

src_members.sig: public bool TrySpend(CurrencyDefinition currency, int amount)
src_members.name: TrySpend
src_members.comment: Returns false (and leaves the balance untouched) if the wallet can't afford it — always check the return value rather than assuming the spend went through.

src_members.sig: public void LoadSaveData(List<SaveEntry> data, GameDataRegistry<CurrencyDefinition> registry)
src_members.name: LoadSaveData
src_members.comment: `registry` resolves each saved currencyId back to its CurrencyDefinition asset — pass the same GameDataRegistry<CurrencyDefinition> your game's currencies are registered in.
